A few practical things.

Can I use it as my everyday app?

Not yet. The Linux prototype is for development and testing. Windows video support, Android, remote control, extended displays and installers remain unfinished. The current transport has no authentication or encryption; only test it on a trusted local network.

Will it work over Wi-Fi?

That’s the primary goal. The current transport supports local networking, but real Wi-Fi playback, recovery and capture-to-display latency still need physical-device testing.

What about a USB-C cable?

Compatible Thunderbolt or USB4 networking can connect two computers directly. An arbitrary USB-C cable and two USB-C ports do not guarantee support. Ethernet is another wired option. Capture and video processing still introduce delay.

Does my screen go to the cloud?

The app is designed to send screen data over your local network without a cloud account. Secure pairing and encryption still need to be built before broader use.
